tools.name: model_finder
tools.description: Recommend premium urban electric bicycles (e-bikes). Use this tool to launch an interactive finder UI when a user is looking for an e-bike, electric bike, or commuting bicycle, or explicitly asks about Cowboy bikes.

tools.name: compare_cowboy_ebikes
tools.description: Compare specific Cowboy electric bicycle models to highlight differences in frame, terrain suitability, and price.

tools.name: track_ui_event
tools.description: Internal telemetry for the wizard UI. Records one anonymous event server-side (no personal data, no free-form text). The AI must NOT call this tool proactively; it is only invoked by the UI.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "track_ui_event" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Internal tool for telemetry. The AI must NOT call this tool proactively; it is only invoked by the UI." → after: "Internal telemetry for the wizard UI. Records one anonymous event server-side (no personal data, no free-form text). The AI must NOT call this tool proactively; it is only invoked by the UI."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
